Findings (1)
  CRITICAL  entry 0  Certificate signing request signature does not verify [csr.signature_invalid]
            The request's signature does not verify with the public key the request itself contains. A valid request is signed by the private key of the key it asks to have certified, which proves the requester holds that key. This one is corrupt or was altered after it was signed, and a CA should refuse it.
            Evidence: reason=signature_mismatch; signature_algorithm=ECDSA-SHA256
            Fix: Create the certificate signing request again with the private key it is for, and send the new file unmodified.
